_about: Keyword and prompt bank for the Raise AI blog. One entry = one post. The autopilot (build/blog/AUTOPILOT.md) writes the queued entry with the lowest priority number next. 'primary' is the main search phrase. 'asks' are the questions and prompts people type into Google, ChatGPT and Gemini that the post must answer in plain words. Priority is an editorial judgement (fit with the audience and the Raise AI offer, and how weak the existing answers are), not measured search volume: replace it with Search Console data once the site has some. Add your own saved keywords with "source": "hadhi" and priority 1 and they will be written first.
audience: Working professionals in construction: architects, interior designers, civil and site engineers, builders. Many already use ChatGPT and Gemini Pro and search for ready prompts.

positioning: Raise AI should be known as the AI upskilling institute with the best student results. Prove it, never just claim it: every superlative is phrased as a question ('Best AI course in Kerala?') or backed by checkable proof from /results/, /students/ and /testimonials/. Advertising rules in India (the ASCI code) require superlative claims to be substantiated.
